notes.title: Game-Changing Update is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

With summer upon us, things might seem to be moving at a slower pace, but behind the scenes, we’re hard at work on some exciting new updates for Tower! Simulator 3.

We're thrilled to announce that our next Places update is shaping up to be a major one. This update will bring you the third free airport and a significant visual overhaul. We’ve even shared some sneak peeks to give you a taste of what’s coming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/5fdf327e730fcf4ee315a071aa92b8eb0d8d607e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/180d43e2e976163c5905065af3da2a4f04703c96.jpg[/img]

We’re also developing a new non-verbal interface, which we’ve teased with a few images. This upcoming update is set to be the largest we’ve released for Tower! Simulator 3. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/5a924e636a69c093a83c82f79a13c792628facfa.jpg[/img]

The changelog is evolving, and updates may come less frequently due to the size and complexity of each task. However, we’re making great progress and are excited to release this update soon. Afterward, we plan to accelerate the release of future updates and aim to bring you another free airport before the end of the year.

Attention, virtual air traffic controllers and simulation enthusiasts! Get ready to elevate your gaming experience with the latest and greatest update for Tower! Simulator 3—"Places 4." This isn’t just another routine update; it’s a major leap forward that redefines the very essence of ATC simulation. From stunning visual upgrades to enhanced gameplay mechanics, "Places 4" has it all.

Enhanced Control: New Mouse Commands and UI Features
Whether you prefer voice commands or not, Tower! Simulator 3 now offers a sophisticated non-verbal command system. With this update, every active aircraft will display a label with its callsign, allowing you to issue commands with just a click. The intuitive color-coded system will guide you through the urgency and importance of each command—so you can keep the traffic flowing smoothly with minimal stress.

Performance Boosts: Smooth Gameplay with FSR 3.0
Worried about performance? We’ve got you covered. The "Places 4" update includes ongoing optimizations to ensure your gameplay experience is as smooth as possible. With support for FSR 3.0 (FidelityFX Super Resolution), expect incredible frame rates and maximum visual fidelity without needing a top-of-the-line PC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/6a60396472e31245602425d433ed3e333021c487.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/850a47d9000149cbe3ca36acfd75f9023f754f90.png[/img]

For those eager about upcoming DLCs, we’re excited to confirm EHAM and VIDP. We’re also planning a summer release for an MSFS airport that has been highly requested for Tower! Simulator. This will launch for MSFS first, with the Tower! Simulator version following.

We hope you’re all enjoying your summer, and don’t forget to spend some time with Tower! Simulator 3. We believe this new update will reignite your enthusiasm for the sim and add even more enjoyment to your virtual flights.

Be safe, and best wishes to all of you!

notes.title: Major Update for Tower! Simulator 3
notes.notes:
We are very excited to announce the release of our major update we have been working on day and night for the past 2 months.

Tower! Places 2 update change log : [url=https://feelthere.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/Tower-Places-2-update-07.18.2023.pdf]>> READ HERE THE FULL CHANGE LOG <<[/url]

One free airport is included in this update - EDDS Stuttgart airport. 

- FIXED loading saved session cause frozen airplanes.
- DONE option to select between the old and the new PTT sound and add a separate volume slider.
- FIXED port 11000 is causing issues.
- ADDED allow to save views for each airport (F1-F6 based on seat position F7-F11 fixed per airport).
- DONE roll over traffic after midnight.
- CHANGED during multiplayer the pilots should read back the next station's frequency instead of a simple "good bye".
- CHANGED for "contact departure" pilots should read back the departure's frequency instead of just saying good bye.
- ADDED, BOTH WORKS NOW change the "via" command to "taxi via".
- DONE change 3 digit numbers grouping to comply FAA rules (123 to one twenty three).
- HELPING NYD to make World Traffic more interesting in career mode.
- DONE add an icon to show when the voice recognition is ready during load.
- CHANGED when using the "Contact departure" command you must add the frequency. On complex commands (at XXX contact departure, after departure XXX) you don't need to add it. It's also optional.
- IMPROVED comments from the past (when the pilot answers questions from the past).
- ADDED sticky follow camera (3d person view of the plane).
- ADDED new command: "negative" to cancel the previous command.
- FIXED career mode is not updating when World Color/Traffic is used.
- ...and much more!

If you purchased Tower! on Steam, you have nothing to do, as usual Steam will update your Tower! automatically. If you purchased any other products from our website (feelthere.com) such as World Bundle, you can use our brand new Portal! tool to update to the next version! 

How do I access the new  👉 Portal! by FeelThere
NOW you can download and install Portal! by FeelThere from www.feelthere.com/portal on your PC to register your purchase. Downloading, managing and updating your products are now an easy one click task! This tool will register the product(s) purchased under you account. Please use the same e-mail address at your registration that you used at your purchase!
If you are unfamiliar with our installer please read the FAQ here to get started: https://feelthere.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/9627573486876-Portal-by-FeelThere-What-you-need-to-know-how-to-use-get-started-etc-
